name: seatgeist
description: KDE Plasma desktop-control substrate for Codex CLI via MCP, skills, hooks, and a local daemon.

interface.shortDescription: Use KDE Plasma desktop apps from Codex through local MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: Seatgeist exposes a local KDE Plasma desktop-control runtime to Codex. It provides screenshots, window state, input, clipboard, accessibility metadata, safety policy, and audit logging through MCP tools and reusable skills.
defaultPrompt: Control KDE Plasma safely with retained window capture and policy-gated actions
